reserveReview.rationale: Renewed 2026-11-19. The dated primary source is the issuer's timestamped snapshots endpoint; its newest entry at 2026-11-19T18:00:45.197Z lists holdings in only two token identities, USDtb (mint 8yXrtJ54jZtE84xEBzTESKuegjcAkAuDrdAhRd8i8n3T) and USDC (mint EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v), across anchorage, coinbase and program reserve accounts. Weights were computed by summing the snapshot's account amounts per token and dividing by total holdings of 40,081,981.84: USDtb 28,949,734.11 (72.2263%) and USDC 11,132,247.73 (27.7737%), rounded to 72.2/27.8. Holdings cover 100.30% of the 39,963,258.57 JupUSD total supply. The live data endpoint read the same day returns identical amounts. The same endpoint's 2026-07-13T18:00:43.210Z snapshot reproduces the prior curated mix (88.6278% / 11.3722%), confirming continuity with the July curation; the book has since drifted from the documented 90/10 target. The runtime adapter owns current live percentages. Both reviewed rows are mapped to tracked upstream stablecoins and the snapshot contains no unknown holding.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Issuer documentation names Anchorage Porto for custody; the live reserve API additionally labels Coinbase and program reserve accounts. The documents do not establish token-holder legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation terms, provider replacement arrangements, or custody-provider shares. Onchain account balances verify assets but not the offchain legal safeguards.
